content.short: Catizen is a highly popular Play-to-Earn 'Tap-to-Earn' game on Telegram featuring cute cats and on-chain rewards.
content.description: Catizen is a massively popular and visually charming Play-to-Earn social game built on the TON blockchain and accessible via Telegram. Players manage a virtual cat café, merging and leveling up cute cat characters to earn rewards and participate in the game's vibrant economy. With its engaging social mechanics, seasonal events, and deep integration with TON wallets, Catizen has successfully captured the attention of millions of players, serving as a primary gateway for new users to explore the world of Web3 gaming and digital asset ownership on TON.
content.meta: Join millions of players in Catizen, the top cat-themed game on TON. Play and earn on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
content.pageTitle: Catizen - Decentralized Games - Lancers Web3 Explorer
